text:
arjun: hey team — quick onboarding Qs before my first day tomorrow: do I need to enroll my personal Mac in MDM to take the phishing sim? also when is the mandatory security training due? thanks!

leah: welcome! you don't have to enroll a personal device if you prefer not to, but company policy requires MDM + disk encryption on any company-issued laptop. we're shipping your laptop today (tracking emailed). security training is due within 7 days of start. link to the course will be in your inbox. :raised_hands:

morgan: to add — the phishsim emails are account-based, so you will get them regardless of device. doing the training and completing the micro-modules will mark you compliant. if you opt out of MDM on a personal device, you may be restricted from certain internal apps.

it-help: Shipping update: laptop sent via FedEx, tracking #FDX123456789. For macOS enroll steps (once you have the laptop):

1) Open Company Portal -> Sign in with SSO
2) Install "Redwood MDM" profile when prompted
3) Enable FileVault in System Preferences > Privacy & Security > FileVault

If you need a manual enroll: run the following in Terminal (admin creds required):

```
sudo profiles renew -type enrollment
```

Reply here if you hit an error and we'll open a ticket.

sam-security: FYI on phishsim: simulations start on day 3 and are low-friction — if you click a simulated link you'll be routed to a 3–5 min microtraining, not penalized. mandatory course is "Security Essentials" in the LMS; it's short but required. If you have privacy concerns about personal devices, ping me directly and we can scope your access.

arjun: thanks — one more: contractors — do they follow the same MDM/FileVault rules? and VPN certs for dev tools?

leah: contractors who need access to sensitive data must be on an enrolled device and complete the same training + sign the AUP. contractors with read-only public docs get a narrowed access path (no MDM). VPN: corporate certs are issued after IT approves access. I'll DM the contractor checklist.

onboard-bot: reminder: new-joiner security checklist due in 7 days — 1) MDM enroll (company devices) 2) Enable FileVault 3) MFA setup 4) Complete "Security Essentials" training 5) Read AUP.

morgan: any blockers, tag @it-help or @sam-security and we'll triage quickly. :thumbsup:
